title: League of the Three Emperors
summary: The English Wikipedia article "League of the Three Emperors", at revision 1377030972, opens: "The League of the Three Emperors, or Union of the Three Emperors, was an alliance between the German, Russian and Austro-Hungarian empires, from 1873 to 1887." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q567712, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
